headline: Iran officially confirms overnight US attack on Qeshm Island, claims no damage to vital services
dek: Iran has confirmed an overnight US attack on Qeshm Island (four explosions heard Sunday night), but says it caused no damage to vital infrastructure or essential services. Deputy governor of Hormozgan province Ahmad Nafisi told IRIB the strikes hit areas outside residential and commercial zones…
sources: Fars News (provincial official) via Reuters, carried by Times of India; IRIB (deputy governor Ahmad Nafisi) via Al Jazeera liveblog
fault_line: Was Sunday's Qeshm strike a 'minor' warning shot, or proof the war is still live while Trump talks peace?

sections.what_happened: Iran has confirmed an overnight US attack on Qeshm Island (four explosions heard Sunday night), but says it caused no damage to vital infrastructure or essential services. Deputy governor of Hormozgan province Ahmad Nafisi told IRIB the strikes hit areas outside residential and commercial zones and 'the situation on Qeshm Island is under control'. AJ explainer (06:45 GMT = 10:45 ) recaps: US first struck Qeshm Nov 2, again Nov 6 (Trump confirmed 'minor' strikes on an anti-aircraft device), and again Sunday night; Qeshm is a key node of Iran's naval power and its desalination plant was hit in March, cutting water to 30 villages.
sections.what_verified: 2 distinct publisher families: Reuters (T1) via ToI citing Fars; Al Jazeera (T2, state-flagged QA) liveblog citing IRIB. ToI (T3) is a carrier of the Reuters report, not an additional family. PASS gate met.
sections.what_disputed: The US has not commented on Sunday's Qeshm strike specifically (Trump confirmed only the Nov 2/6 'minor' strikes). Iranian state TV initially suggested the Sunday blasts might be Iranian military activity; Tasnim attributed them to the US before any official confirmation. The 'no damage to vital infrastructure' claim is Iran's own and is not independently verified by imagery.
sections.why_matters: Iran itself confirms the US hit Qeshm — the strike Washington already admitted, now confirmed from Tehran, with no damage claimed. The 'highly unlikely' talks track vs the 38-bridges threat.
sections.context: Background: MISSED CATCH-UP + IN-WINDOW -- Iran officially confirms overnight US attack on Qeshm Island, claims no damage to vital services

totw_analysis: Our read: Iran itself confirms the US hit Qeshm — the strike Washington already admitted, now confirmed from Tehran, with no damage claimed. The 'highly unlikely' talks track vs the 38-bridges threat. The fault line our audience is arguing over: Was Sunday's Qeshm strike a 'minor' warning shot, or proof the war is still live while Trump talks peace?
